//: Capability manifest for kpi_sparkline_list/1 — keen-pure-admin. See table-card.map.json for the header/body/footer-card model and stacked-bar.map.json for the deferred-row-sub-component model. SCOPE = the pa-kpi-spark-list container card chrome the component emits inline (canonical .pa-card__title header + .pa-kpi-live pill, the pa-kpi-spark-list__body region, the pa-kpi-footer footer) + the two block modifiers --no-delta / --chart-first. The ROWS are a SEPARATE sibling component (kpi_sparkline_row/1) fed through the inner_block slot; the dumper passes slot content as plain escaped text, so the whole pa-kpi-spark-row* family is the DEFERRED row sub-slice, not mapped here. Title is the canonical .pa-card__title > .pa-card__title-text (blessed) — keen was fixed to emit this (it previously emitted a bare <h3>). footer_text is a plain string prop (the richer footer slot is out of this string-scoped slice). live_text defaults to 'LIVE'.
